source.rule: CLAUDE_ANNEX 17c: every firm adapter writes exactly this schema; a firm-specific column does not survive into gold
source.row_grain: one row per distinct record_id that passes ingest and is not held out
source.not_a_field_reason: an external send is approved; approval is not a property of the commentary row

schema_hash_rule: sha256 of the newline-joined lines name|type|nullable(1/0) over fields in order; the builder stamps it into the parquet metadata as opal_contract_schema_hash
coverage_markers: claim per field: measured, inferred, held, absent; a nullable field is null where its claim is absent

fields.name: record_id
fields.derivation: silver.record_id, carried unchanged (the message id digest; the dedup key)

fields.name: sent_at
fields.derivation: silver.received_at, carried as the ISO-8601 UTC text the bronze sidecar holds; sentDateTime is not returned by the read path, so this is the receive time

fields.name: recipient_firm
fields.derivation: silver.recipient_firm, carried: the registry FIRM scope key whose tenant.email_domain matched the recipient

fields.name: yc_variant
fields.derivation: 1/2/3 from the count of distinct models_referenced: 0 -> 1, 1 -> 2, 2 or more -> 3

fields.name: models_referenced
fields.derivation: model_aliases.json aliases matched in body_text (longest match wins, no overlap), each mapped to its IRPT comparison_key, or to its canonical name where the key is null; sorted, distinct

fields.name: account_type
fields.derivation: keyword rules over body_text, first hit in order roth, ira, 401k, brokerage, trust, else household

fields.name: themes
fields.type: list<struct<theme: string, client_figure: string, model_figure: string>>
fields.derivation: one entry per heading block; client_figure and model_figure are the first 'X% versus Y%' / 'X% vs Y%' / 'X versus Y' pair in the first paragraph after the heading (first figure client, second model), else null inside the struct

fields.name: paragraph_hashes
fields.derivation: sha256 hex of each silver block's text, in block order

fields.name: pdf_sha256
fields.derivation: sha256 of the YCharts PDF attachment bytes; the empty string this round because attachment bytes ride S12 and are not in silver (coverage marker: claim absent)

fields.name: holdings
fields.derivation: JSON text of the holdings table parsed from the PDF; null until PDF bytes land

fields.name: request_text
fields.derivation: the client's request text when the PDF carries one; null until PDF bytes land
